mr|warranty.note: quote from the OEM — not carried on the reference jobs

mr|conduit.note: 300 LF — Underground conduit & cable (make-ready). Scope includes: furnish & install Sch 40 PVC conduit in parallel runs, pull conductors (3 wires/run + EGC), couplings/sweeps/fittings, mule tape, and terminations from the service to each charging station. Footage includes elevation/slack per run. Code-compliant trench per NEC 300.5.

mr|conduitAG.note: 40 LF — Above-ground/indoor conduit & cable. Scope includes: furnish & install RMC (exposed/riser) or PVC where permitted, straps/standoffs, fittings, conductor pull and terminations from the house/owner panel to the outdoor distribution panel.

mr|trench.note: 120 LF — Trenching & backfill through continuously-paved area (asphalt/concrete). Scope includes: saw-cutting pavement, excavation to required depth, spoils haul-off/disposal, gravel and sand bedding & backfill, mechanical compaction in lifts, base-course millings, hot-mix asphalt patch, and rolling to restore the driving surface to compacted grade. Per NEC 300.5 (24-in min cover, warning tape).

mr|restore.note: 120 LF — Surface restoration and/or remediation over the trench route. Scope includes: base-course millings, hot-mix asphalt patch or concrete replacement to match existing, rolling to compacted grade, and landscape reinstatement where disturbed.

mr|bollard.note: 10 EA — Protective bollards. Scope includes: furnish & install concrete-filled steel pipe bollards, core/excavate footing, set in concrete, prime & paint safety-yellow. Count is one per Level 2 port (10); the drawing shows 4.

mr|svcPedestal.note: 2 service pedestals on the site map — meter socket + main on a freestanding pedestal, a new utility service; pedestal hardware is an allowance, confirm against the utility spec

mr|xfmrpad.note: 1 EA — Utility transformer/service pad (3'x5'). Scope includes: excavate & form, pour reinforced concrete pad, set conduit stub-ups and grounding, finish & cure for the new pad-mount service.

mr|concrete.note: 5 EA — Concrete EVSE equipment bases (one per dual-port pedestal, serving 10 ports). Scope includes: form & pour reinforced concrete pad or sonotube, anchor bolts/template, conduit stub-ups, finish & cure to charger mounting spec.
